title: Sniper Cohorts and Algorithmic Filter Rejections in Solana Memecoin Markets: Two-Window Replication of Lifecycle-Stage Population Separation
abstract: arXiv:2609.18975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prior empirical work on Solana memecoin markets has often conflated pre-graduation (bonding-curve) and post-graduation (open-market) token populations. We test the assumption of population overlap between two independent algorithmic detection streams operating on the same underlying market: sniper-cohort detection and algorithmic filter rejection. Using two non-overlapping observation windows (June 11 to June 25, 2026, and June 29 to July 16, 2026) and two independent versions of the cohort-detection pipeline (v1 and v2), we compute set overlap between cohort-detected mints and rejection-stream mints in each window. Overlap remains under 1 percent of the cohort population in both windows despite substantial variation in cohort detector selectivity (v1: 20,162 mints; v2: 623 mints) and rejection-stream coverage (v1 window: 83 mints; v2 window: 1,743 mints). translated_title: Solana Meme币市场中的狙击者群体与算法过滤拒绝：生命周期阶段群体分离的双窗口复制研究
translated_abstract: 此前关于Solana Meme币市场的实证研究常常混淆了毕业前（联合曲线阶段）和毕业后（公开市场阶段）的代币群体。我们检验了在同一底层市场上运行的两个独立算法检测流之间的群体重叠假设：狙击者群体检测和算法过滤拒绝。利用两个不重叠的观察窗口（2026年6月11日至6月25日，以及2026年6月29日至7月16日）和群体检测管线的两个独立版本（v1和v2），我们计算了每个窗口中群体检测发现的铸币与拒绝流铸币之间的集合重叠度。尽管群体检测器的选择性存在显著差异（v1：20,162个铸币；v2：623个铸币），且拒绝流覆盖范围变化很大（v1窗口：83个铸币；v2窗口：1,743个铸币），两个窗口中的重叠度均保持在群体数量的1%以下。这种生命周期阶段的分离是结构性的而非统计性的：群体检测……
tldr: 该研究通过两个独立观察窗口验证了Solana Meme币市场中狙击者群体检测与算法过滤拒绝两个检测流的重叠度低于1%，证明毕业前联合曲线阶段与毕业后公开市场阶段的代币群体存在结构性而非统计性的分离。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through two independent observation windows that sniper-cohort detection and algorithmic filter rejection streams in Solana memecoin markets show under 1% population overlap, revealing a structural rather than statistical separation between pre-graduation and post-graduation token lifecycle stages.
